long_biography.plain_text:
Costa spent about 25 years as an owner and operator at Costa Farms, the ornamental-plant supplier founded by his grandfather in 1961. He led its foliage division as executive vice president while the family business expanded through acquisitions and large retail customers. In 2017, Markel acquired an 81 percent interest, with the management team remaining in place.

That year Costa established Fourshore Capital in Coral Gables as a platform for real-estate lending, private equity and special-situation investments. The firm backs established companies across agribusiness, logistics, manufacturing, distribution, consumer and financial services. Costa also founded and chairs Florida Victorious, a University of Florida athletics organization, and serves on the Costa Farms board. He earned degrees from the University of Florida and the University of Miami.
